name: vision_onnx_service_bad
title: The same train/export/serve triple with eight planted defects, five of them train-serve skew
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_onnx_service

expected.defect: Classifier.forward ends in nn.Softmax while the objective is nn.CrossEntropyLoss
expected.why: the probabilities are log-softmaxed twice, and the exported graph then emits probabilities the service softmaxes a third time

expected.defect: pick_device() hard-codes cuda:0 with no availability check anywhere in the workspace
expected.why: the export job dies on the CPU build machine that is meant to produce the artefact

expected.defect: the checkpoint is reloaded with neither map_location= nor weights_only=True
expected.why: an untrusted checkpoint executes arbitrary code, and a CUDA-saved file fails to load on the serving host

forbidden.why: the training loader still passes shuffle=True
the validation loader still passes shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
eval_transform() and serving_transform() are both deterministic; the defect is that they disagree with each other, not that either is random
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is still called every batch
optimizer.step() is still called every batch
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
the running loss still accumulates loss.item()
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the images and labels are still moved to the model's device
seed_everything() still seeds random, numpy and torch
the two splits are still two directories

gaps.what: the service normalises with (0.5,0.5,0.5) and resizes to 224 before cropping to 224, while training and validation normalise with the ImageNet statistics after a resize to 256 - a textbook train-serve skew that silently costs accuracy in production only (MLV901 is later-tier and unimplemented)

export_onnx() traces the module in train mode, so the exported graph freezes whatever BatchNorm statistics the last training batch left and bakes in a live dropout node - no rule checks the mode a model is exported in
the exported model already ends in a softmax and the service applies another one, so every served confidence is near uniform
a new onnxruntime InferenceSession is constructed per request
/predict_raw skips preprocess() entirely and feeds a [0,255] uint8 array to a model trained on normalised input
